rules: Input audit is a bounded observation, never authority or a model success receipt.
Physical writes and confirmed Root boundaries are separate fields. A rollback or missing audit cannot erase an external effect.
Audit acknowledgement completes outside Root/model/Core and before releasing input serialization. Overflow/failure quarantines and stops or retains owned uncertainty.
Original failure survives later cleanup errors. Separate exact fixture recovery never rewrites the unknown product observation.
